donations.title: Donations
donations.subtitle: Donated products, recognised from the photo.
donations.emptyTable: No photo registered yet. Use “Register product” to take the first one.

newDonation.title: Register donated product
newDonation.subtitle: Take a photo of the pack or the barcode. We look up the EAN first; if there is no code, a vision model suggests the product.
newDonation.cameraLabel: Take a photo of the donated product
newDonation.noPermission: You do not have permission to register donations.
newDonation.eanOptionalHint: If the photo is not read automatically, type the EAN so we hit the catalogue / Open Food Facts instead of the AI.

via.ean: Resolved from the barcode (catalogue or Open Food Facts).
via.vision: The vision model read the product photo. Check name and quantity.
via.manual: Could not identify it. Fill in the details by hand.

newDonation.mergeHint: Is this the same product already in this collection centre?
newDonation.mergeNew: No: create a new one (only if it is a different SKU)

result.failedHint: The photo was saved. You can retry it from the donations list.
result.needsConfirmHint: Inventory is not updated until you confirm. You can edit the name and quantity.
result.unidentifiedHint: The product was not recognised with enough confidence. It stays pending review so someone can confirm it by hand.

newDonation.confirmInvalid: Enter a name and a quantity greater than zero.
newDonation.needAcopio: Choose a collection centre before confirming.

review.title: Donation review
review.subtitle: Photos that recognition could not resolve with enough confidence.
review.noPermission: You do not have permission to review donations.
review.emptyHint: All photos were recognised with enough confidence. They show up here again if any is left unidentified.
review.noText: No text was read in the photo.
review.emptyCatalog: The product catalogue is empty: with no products loaded there is nothing to assign and recognition cannot succeed.
review.loadError: Could not load the review queue

confirm.deleteAcopioDescription: It is permanently removed. Donations already registered there are left with no centre assigned.
confirm.removeMemberDescription: They lose access to the organisation. They can be reactivated later, but stop seeing the data immediately.
confirm.deleteRoleDescription: Anyone assigned to it is left with no permissions until another role is assigned.

acopios.title: Collection centres
acopios.subtitle: Warehouses are registered here: whether they receive donations, send them out, or both. They are not created when setting up the organisation.
acopios.empty: No collection centres yet. Create the first one with the form below.

users.title: Users
users.inviteEmail: Email of the person to invite

roles.title: Roles and permissions
roles.subtitle: The matrix is system-wide: a change applies to every organisation. New rows appear as modules are added (donations, shipments).

onboarding.chooseTitle: How do you want to continue?

dashboard.switchOrg: {{nombre}} ({{correo}}) can switch organisation when they belong to more than one.

dashboard.rolesHint: Editable matrix: roles, permissions and new entries.
